subject: SIG activation & SOC2 snapshot — prefill + clarifying questions
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:10:12-07:00
Subject: SIG activation & SOC2 snapshot — prefill + clarifying questions

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a small set of asks so we can kick off the security questionnaire on our side: 

1) Questionnaire type: you mentioned being open to SIG or CAIQ as a first pass. For speed, we usually start with CAIQ + short SIG prefill where customers prefer the vendor-ready form. Please confirm which you'd like us to prefill (CAIQ preferred by us for automated mapping).

2) SOC 2 status: can you confirm the latest SOC 2 type (SOC 2 Type II in-scope systems) and whether a redacted report is available for vendors? A one-page summary or attestation is sufficient to start.

3) HIPAA/GDPR: you flagged HIPAA applicability — can you confirm whether PioneerHealth will treat Redwood as a Business Associate for any PHI flows? Also let us know the EU data residency / DPA requirements (if any).

4) Evidence & POC: please share the security team contact and a drive link for any artifacts you can share (SOC2 summary, IAAS diagrams, subprocessors list). We can accept redacted PDFs or a secure share.

Attached is our quick SIG-prefill template — if you can populate a few cells or point us to a location, we will translate into the formal SIG/CAIQ and return a filled copy.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm questionnaire preference (CAIQ or SIG) by EOD Thu 5/20
- Pioneer provides SOC2 summary and security POC by Fri 5/21
- We produce an initial prefill and open a HubSpot ticket for evidence tracking by Mon 5/24

If anything above is off, tell me and we'll adjust. Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
Attachment: SIG-prefill-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Emma Torres <emma@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@pioneerhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:28:40-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG activation & SOC2 snapshot — prefill + clarifying questions

Hi Priyom — appreciate the clear recap. Answers inline below: 

- Questionnaire: CAIQ first please — we have an internal mapping to CAIQ that speeds our reviews. If you can prefill CAIQ fields we will review and provide any follow-ups.

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II last quarter (service org report). I can share a redacted one-pager and our SOC contact. Attaching a redacted summary now.

- HIPAA/GDPR: PioneerHealth is HIPAA-regulated and we treat vendors handling PHI as Business Associates. We will require a BAA if Redwood will process PHI. For GDPR, our default is a standard DPA — EU residency preferred but not mandatory for the initial integration (we'll confirm for production workloads).

- Evidence & POC: Security lead is Oliver Grant (oliver.grant@pioneerhealth.com). He prefers SharePoint links. I'll ask him to share the subprocessor list and IAAS diagram.

We should be able to meet the timeline you proposed — I'll confirm with Oliver and share anything we can by Friday.

Thanks,
Emma
Senior Product Manager, PioneerHealth
Attachment: SOC2-summary-redacted.pdf (redacted attestation)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@pioneerhealth.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T13:02:05-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG activation & SOC2 snapshot — prefill + clarifying questions

Emma / Oliver — thanks for the quick reply and for the SOC summary. A couple of clarifying questions from our side to make sure the prefill is accurate: 

- PHI scope: when you say Redwood would be a Business Associate, can you confirm the intended data flows (e.g., will Pioneer send raw PHI text to Redwood endpoints, or will PHI be tokenized/hashed before sending)? This affects our recommended deployment (private vs hosted) and BAA language.

- Subprocessors: can you confirm whether any of your subprocessors are in-scope for access to plaintext data (e.g., logging/monitoring agents, analytics vendors)? If so, please flag their names and whether they have separate BAAs.

- Access controls / retention: do you have specific retention or log access windows we should align to (e.g., logs accessible for 90 days, audit logs for 1 year)? We can map our evidence pages to those retention periods in the CAIQ prefill.

- Evidence format: SharePoint links are fine. If you can add a viewer link for the SOC summary + subprocessor list, that will speed validation.

I'll start filling the CAIQ with what we have on our side and will mark any fields needing your confirmation. Monica — looping you for assistance on the CAIQ fields that map to Redwood's runtime configuration and BAA practice.

Action items now: I will create HubSpot record RDW-8734 and attach the CAIQ prefill once drafted (expected Mon 5/24). If Pioneer prefers a BAA conversation first, let me know and we can route to Legal early.

Best,
Priyom
Attachment: (none)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Emma Torres <emma@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG activation & SOC2 snapshot — prefill + clarifying questions

Hi Priyom / Emma / Monica — Oliver here (security lead). Thanks for looping me in. Quick answers to Priyom's clarifying items: 

- PHI flows: initial integration will send de-identified clinical notes. For production we expect limited PHI (identifiers removed) but we will need to agree on a BAA in principle.

- Subprocessors: our primary infra/logging vendor is CloudLogix (they do not receive plaintext PHI). Analytics vendor DataView receives only metadata. I'll upload the subprocessor list to SharePoint and grant viewer access to priyom.das@redwood.com.

- Retention: default audit/log retention is 180 days; we can negotiate 90 days for vendor access if required.

SharePoint link (viewer): https://sharepoint.pioneerhealth.org/sites/sec/SIG-RDW-8734

I'll expect the CAIQ prefill and will review. If a short call (~20 mins) helps to walk CAIQ edge cases, I'm available Tue 5/25 10–12 PT.

Oliver Grant
Head of Information Security, PioneerHealth
